name: Lamp
description: A bulb that lights up when the value is on (1, true, on, yes, ok, done…).
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<style>
.glow{opacity:0}.bulb{fill:#3b4060}.ray{opacity:0;stroke:#ffd54a;stroke-width:4;stroke-linecap:round}
[data-state="on"] .glow{opacity:1}[data-state="on"] .bulb{fill:#ffd54a}[data-state="on"] .ray{opacity:.9}
</style>
<defs><radialGradient id="g"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffe680" stop-opacity=".95"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffe680" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient></defs>
